breakdown.description: At 12 K > T_c, the material is in the normal state rather than the zero-resistance superconducting state.
breakdown.reason: While the Agent correctly identified that at 12 K > T_c the material is in the normal state (not superconducting), the ground truth prompt specifies the measurement should be at 4.2 K (below T_c), which would put the material in the superconducting state. The Agent addressed the incorrect temperature of 12 K by correcting the state description, but did not correct the measurement temperature to 4.2 K as specified in the ground truth. The generated specification still uses 12 K as the measurement temperature rather than 4.2 K.
